name: neon-mdf-tools
description: Build/flash/monitor UI cho neon-mdf (bootloader + app), giong ESP-IDF extension - khong thay the flash_targets.cmake/.vscode/tasks.json, chi la lop UI goi lai.

neonMdf.target.description: Target dang chon (vd WEACT_F412) - doc dong tu CMakePresets.json, khong hardcode.

neonMdf.transport.description: Giao tiep nap firmware. FU2: UART qua ROMCODE, chon boot mode 100 va bam RESET khi tool san sang. STM32: UART System Bootloader hoac JTAG/SWD theo board.

neonMdf.baudRate.description: Baud UART ung dung/Serial Monitor, doc lap voi baud nap. Khi chua dat, FU2 dung 19200; target khac dung 115200.

neonMdf.fu2FlashBaudRate.description: Baud nap UART FU2, phai khop ROMCODE tren board. Truyen luc chay target CMake; khong thay doi baud tren chip.

neonMdf.sdkPath.description: Duong dan TUYET DOI toi neon-mdf SDK (giong idf.espIdfPath cua ESP-IDF). De trong = tu dong suy tu vi tri app (../../neon-mdf), giong quy uoc cac vi du co san dang dung. Chi can dat neu SDK nam o vi tri khac quy uoc - dung lenh 'NEON-MDF: Chon Duong Dan SDK...' thay vi sua truc tiep o day.
